items.title: LINGUA Africa Open Call for Inclusive AI Language Projects
items.normalizedTitle: lingua africa open call inclusive ai language projects
items.organizer: Microsoft AI for Good Lab, Gates Foundation, Masakhane African Languages Hub, Google.org
items.notes: Supports startups and other orgs building African language datasets, models, tools, and sector applications with cash plus compute credits.

items.title: EIC Accelerator
items.notes: Deep-tech funding route for high-risk, high-impact startups and SMEs, including AI companies; next 2026 batching date is 8 July 2026.

items.title: MEST AI Startup Program 2027
items.notes: Fully sponsored AI entrepreneurship training in Accra, followed by incubation and up to $100,000 in pre-seed investment for top teams.

items.title: Women in Tech Accelerator 2026
items.organizer: Village Capital and Standard Chartered Foundation
items.notes: Supports women-led, tech-enabled startups in Botswana, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, and Zambia with training, networks, and a share of over USD 600K in grants across 12 markets.
